reasons: Accessorial code on invoice (LAD) does not match authorized accessorial (LGD) in BOL.
Amount billed for LAD ($92) does not match Schedule C rate for LAD ($105).
Unauthorized accessorial charge should not be payable.
decision.dispute_summary: Accessorial charge is listed as code LAD (Limited Access Delivery) with amount $92. Schedule C lists LAD at $105 and requires authorization; the BOL authorizes LGD (Liftgate at delivery) at $92. Therefore the billed accessorial is not authorized nor at the correct rate.
